Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: transparent RGBA game weathering decal atlas, for an isometric fantasy dungeon.
Input image: edit target/reference, the existing 1536x1024 atlas in 3 columns and 2 rows. Its background is TRANSPARENT: ignore hidden RGB beneath zero-alpha pixels.
Request: expand the canvas to exactly 2048x1024, 4 columns by 2 rows of 512x512 cells. Keep the two moss decals in column 1 and the two vertical water seep decals in column 3 as close to the input as possible in shape, scale, color and transparency. Do not alter their successful look.
Rework both column-2 crack decals for clear readability at a distant game camera: stronger branching jagged fissures, near-black charcoal central gaps, central fracture widths roughly 8–16 pixels at this 512px cell size, branches 3–7 pixels, near-opaque centers with thin subtle chipped warm grey edges. Fewer, stronger distinct branches rather than tiny pale hairlines. Each irregular crack network spans about 80 percent of its cell. No surrounding stone slab, rock face or wall background: only cracks and thin chipped edges.
Add two DISTINCT dusty spiderweb decals in the new rightmost column 4. Top: irregular triangular corner cobweb spreading from the upper-left anchor down and right, off-white grey-beige silk threads, radial supports and uneven bowed cross threads, a few broken hanging threads and light dusty knots. Bottom: a different old asymmetrical cobweb with a broader upper band and torn lower lacy threads, sparse holes and broken strands. Readably thick 2–5px main strands at 512px cell size, very fine secondary strands. Airy open web: all gaps are fully transparent, not a white veil. No spider, insect, wood frame or wall.
Grid order each row: moss / strong crack / water seep / cobweb. Exactly 4 equal columns × 2 equal rows. Every decal must have 32px transparent padding inside its cell so neighboring cells never touch. Cobwebs mostly fill their cells within that padding. Keep all decals flat, face-on and without baked directional light or cast shadows. Actual transparent RGBA output, not a drawn checkerboard or black background.
Avoid text, visible grid, borders, underlying wall textures, opaque rectangles, big stones around cracks, bright neon green, glowing cracks, rope-like webs or a perfectly geometric circular spiderweb. Preserve the subdued semi-realistic art style.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Input image: reference for strong cracks and cobwebs in a transparent dungeon decal atlas.
Create the final compact atlas of ONLY cracks and cobwebs: exactly 1024x1024 pixels, a 2-column by 2-row grid of 512x512 cells, no visible grid lines.
Top-left: preserve the top strong branching near-black crack from column 2 of the reference. Bottom-left: preserve its second distinct branching crack. Near-opaque charcoal central fissures about 8–16px thick with 3–7px branches, restrained narrow chipped edges. No rock background.
Top-right: old asymmetric triangular corner cobweb, anchored toward the top-left of its cell, off-white dusty grey silk radial supports and uneven curved cross-threads spreading down and right. Bottom-right: a second torn asymmetric corner cobweb with a broader upper band and hanging broken strands.
Crucial web change: remove the dense beige cloth-like veil between strands. These are AIRY OPEN cobwebs made of fine threads, and all spaces between threads are fully transparent. Main threads 2–4px at 512px cell scale, thin secondary threads, occasional little dust knots and wisps at intersections only. No spider or insects. No ropes. Cobweb extent about 80 percent of cell.
Keep each of the four motifs within its cell with at least 32px transparent padding. Background genuinely RGBA transparent including inside gaps, not black, white or a painted checkerboard. Hidden RGB colors under zero-alpha pixels are not part of the design.
Only four isolated decals: cracks in left column, webs in right column. No moss or water stains in this image. Restrained semi-realistic dungeon style, no lighting or cast shadows, no text, no wall or surface background, no rectangular color patches.
